description: This file defines the OutboundEmailAccounts class, which extends the OutboundEmailAccounts_sugar class. It manages SMTP email account configurations, including saving settings, retrieving accounts, handling user permissions, and rendering UI components for email configuration and testing within the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccounts
classes.description: Represents SMTP email account configurations and provides methods for managing outbound email settings, including permission checks, retrieval, and UI rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the email account configuration, including password encryption, authentication type adjustments, and system-wide settings updates.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an email account configuration from the database and decrypts the SMTP password if necessary.

methods.name: getUserOutboundAccounts
methods.description: Returns the list of outbound email accounts accessible to the current user based on permissions.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates and customizes database query for listing email accounts, with user permission filtering.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has access to a personal account, based on user role and ownership.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denial event when a user attempts unauthorized access to a personal account.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Defines access control logic for view permissions, incorporating user roles and permission checks.

methods.name: getFromAddress
methods.description: Returns the email 'from' address, defaulting to SMTP user if email is invalid or not set.

methods.name: getFromName
methods.description: Returns the 'from' name for outgoing emails.

methods.name: getReplyToAddress
methods.description: Returns the reply-to email address, defaulting to 'from' address if not set.

methods.name: keepWriteOnlyFieldValues
methods.description: Ensures that fields designated as write-only are properly populated after data fetch.

methods.name: getPasswordChange
methods.description: Returns HTML and JavaScript for a toggle UI to change SMTP password.

methods.name: getEmailProviderChooser
methods.description: Returns a Smarty-rendered HTML block for SMTP provider selection.

methods.name: getSendTestEmailBtn
methods.description: Returns HTML and JavaScript for the 'send test email' button and dialog, including email validation and test sending logic.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyAction
methods.description: Checks if a given action/view is restricted to admin users.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if a given view/action is security group-based.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if a given action/view is disallowed for certain contexts.
